preliminary_naturality.bone_axes: Existing flexion/spread axes only; index spread -12deg, no extreme lateral escape.
preliminary_naturality.contour: Compared with the Human-rejected earlier third pose, reduced PIP/DIP hook and less index-middle convergence; base-to-tip contour appears more gradual in the viewed overhead and close side images.
preliminary_naturality.palm_wrist: Small retraction and coupled tilt; whole-hand silhouette remains close to original. No forearm/elbow model, no human ergonomic approval.
preliminary_naturality.reservation: Polygonal surface and proximal skin folds remain visible. Human must judge these, finger hover height, thumb forward-edge placement and teaching clarity. Geometry numbers do not certify naturality.

selection_reason: Round 2 has no illegal key intersections, no self/cross-hand regression, original joint domains and active contacts preserved, and looks provisionally plausible; do not spend unused rounds on numerical polishing.
